title: Analytics
description: Event and screen tracking: Firebase Analytics on web, @react-native-firebase/analytics on native (development build).

markers.block:
['@react-native-firebase/app', { ios: { disableSPM: true } }],
    ['expo-build-properties', { ios: { useFrameworks: 'static', forceStaticLinking: ['RNFBApp', 'RNFBAnalytics', 'RNFBRemoteConfig', 'RNFBCrashlytics', 'RNFBPerf', 'RNFBAppCheck', 'RNFBFirestore', 'RNFBAuth', 'RNFBMessaging'] } }],

notes: Native uses analytics.native.ts via Metro platform resolution; requires a development build.
Scaffold app.config points at ./google-services.json and ./GoogleService-Info.plist — radiance setup firebase downloads them.
iOS uses CocoaPods Firebase (disableSPM) with static frameworks — required on Xcode 26+; SPM + dynamic hits SwiftUICore linker errors.
